teaser.en: Raw *mriga* tubers are poisonous, and a look-alike vine is never eaten at all, so knowing this yam is real knowledge.
teaser.sw: Viazi vibichi vya *mriga* vina sumu, na mtambaa unaofanana nao hauliwi kabisa, kwa hiyo kuujua mmea huu wa kiazi kikuu ni elimu ya kweli.
teaser.dg: Viazi vya *mriga* vichikala viitsi vina sumu, na mmea unaohalana nao taurika kabisa, kpwa hivyo kuumanya *mriga* ni marifwa ga kpweli.

summary.en: *Mriga* is the bitter or three-leaved yam, a twining climber of forest edges with large edible tubers. It is eaten only after careful preparation, and the Digo distinguish it from a look-alike that is not eaten.
summary.sw: *Mriga* ni kiazi kikuu chungu, chenye majani matatu, mtambaa unaojizungusha unaoota pembezoni mwa misitu na wenye viazi vikubwa vinavyoliwa. Huliwa tu baada ya kutayarishwa kwa uangalifu, na Wadigo huutofautisha na mmea unaofanana nao usioliwa.
summary.dg: *Mriga* ni *bitter yam* au *three-leaved yam*, mmea unaokpwera na kudzizunguluka wa kanda-kanda ya matsaka, wenye viazi vikulu vinavyoriwa. Nkuriwa bada ya kutengezwa kpwa makini tu, na Adigo anautafwautisha na mmea unaohalana nao ambao taurika.

about.en: *Mriga* is a twining climber that winds up shrubs and small trees. Its leaves are made of three leaflets, which, together with the twining stem, is the easiest way to recognise it. Below ground it forms large tubers.
about.sw: *Mriga* ni mtambaa unaojizungusha juu ya vichaka na miti midogo. Kila jani lina vijani vitatu, na hilo, pamoja na shina linalojizungusha, ndiyo njia rahisi zaidi ya kuutambua. Chini ya ardhi hutengeneza viazi vikubwa.
about.dg: *Mriga* ni mmea unaokpwera na kudzizunguluka, unaodzizunguluka vitsaka na mihi midide. Chila kodza rina makodza madide mahahu, na hino, phamwenga na mlitawe unaodzizunguluka, ndiyo njira rahisi zaidi ya kuumanya. Tsini ya ulongo unahenda viazi vikulu.

where.en: It grows on forest edges and in the bush, often semi-wild.
where.sw: Huota pembezoni mwa misitu na vichakani, mara nyingi ukiwa nusu-pori.
where.dg: Unamera kanda-kanda ya matsaka na weruni, na mara nyinji ni nusu wa tsaka.

uses.en:
The tubers are eaten after careful processing; raw tubers are toxic.

A related look-alike, *mriga yere*, is not eaten.
uses.sw:
Viazi vyake huliwa baada ya kutayarishwa kwa uangalifu; viazi vibichi vina sumu.

Jamaa wake anayefanana naye, *mriga yere*, hauliwi.
uses.dg:
Viazi nkuriwa bada ya kutengezwa kpwa makini; vichikala viitsi vina sumu.

Mmea unaohalana nao, *mriga yere*, taurika.

culture.en: The Digo distinguish true *mriga* from *mriga yere*, 'false *mriga*', a look-alike that is not eaten.
culture.sw: Wadigo hutofautisha *mriga* halisi na *mriga yere*, yaani '*mriga* bandia', mmea unaofanana nao usioliwa.
culture.dg: Adigo anatafwautisha *mriga* wa kpweli na *mriga yere*, '*mriga* wa handzo', mmea unaohalana nao ambao taurika.

names.en: The Digo name *mriga* is shared with Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. The general Swahili word for yam is *kiazi kikuu*. In English it is bitter yam or three-leaved yam.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo *mriga* linatumika pia kwa Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili. Neno la jumla la Kiswahili kwa viazi vya aina hii ni *kiazi kikuu*. Kwa Kiingereza huitwa *bitter yam* au *three-leaved yam*.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo *mriga* rinahumirwa piya kpwa Chiduruma, Chigiryama na Chiswahili. Neno ra Chiswahili ra viazi vikulu vyosi ni *kiazi kikuu*. Kpwa Chingereza unaihwa *bitter yam* au *three-leaved yam*.

reason.en: Another wild tuber that needs preparation before eating
reason.sw: Kiazi kingine cha porini kinachohitaji kutayarishwa kabla ya kuliwa
reason.dg: Chiazi chanjina cha tsaka chinachohitaji kutengezwa kabla ya kuriwa

reason.en: Another root crop that must be processed
reason.sw: Zao jingine la mizizi linalopaswa kutayarishwa
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina wa mizi unaolazimika kutengezwa kabla ya kuriwa
